dialogue.translation: A tɛ fɛn. O sababu fɔlɔ, ala ka karaba kɛ ala ka kelen di.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's go with the bus. We can save money and still have fun.
dialogue.translation: Ee fɔ, ala ka karaba kɛ. Ala bolon di kelen ala ka haw fɛ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to share something every day, but sometimes I just scroll through my feed without posting.
dialogue.translation: N bɛɛ n na kɛmɛ dɔnkili kɛmɛ jɔyi bɛɛ la, nka n bɛɛ n ka tɛmɛ a ka di a ka tɔgɔ cogo la.

dialogue.text: Do you follow many people?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but I mostly follow friends and family. I don't like getting too many likes or comments, so I keep my profile private.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's smart. I have a public profile because I want more people to see my posts.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. But being online all the time can be exhausting, so I limit my time.

dialogue.speaker: A

scenario: Giving a short presentation at work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: A b'a ye a tɛmɛ kelen balimaw fɛ.
A b'a ye dan fɛn bɔyeninw lo.
Ra tiɲɛ kanw, 'tɔgɔ sɛbɛn' ye sanakw tɛmɛna.
A b'a ye fɔlɔɲɛfɛ balimaw la.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's start. My presentation will include three main parts.
dialogue.translation: Aw fɛn, taali. Tiɲɛyiridenw bɛ fɛ tɔgɔ bɔyi sanakw.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds good. What is your first point?
dialogue.translation: A ye fɛn kanakw. I sanakw tɛmɛna ni ye n'a fɔlɔɲɛna?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The first part is about our sales results from last month.
dialogue.translation: Tɛmɛyiridenw tɛmɛna ye fɛn fɔlɔɲɛfɛ ka tɔgɔ bɔyi ye ka kɛlɛbaw ka taa ka tɔgɔ bɔyi ye ka kɛlɛbaw ka taa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And what will you cover next?
dialogue.translation: N'i bɛ se ka fɔlɔɲɛfɛ balimaw la?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Next, I'll talk about our main challenges during that period.
dialogue.translation: Jɛn-fɔlɔɲɛfɛ, ayi bɛ se ka tɔgɔ sanakw ra.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Will you also mention the new marketing strategy?
dialogue.translation: Mɛn, i bɛ se ka jamana kɛlɛbaw ka tɔgɔ bɔyi ye ka kɛlɛbaw ka taa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's an important point, and I'll end with our goals for this month.
dialogue.translation: Aw ye, a ye sanakw kanbaliw, ayi bɛ fɛra ka tɔgɔ bɔyi ye ka kɛlɛbaw ka taa.

scenario: Discussing a sport or hobby you follow
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: A bɔ dɔɲɛ nɛ fɔlɔ wayi bɛɛ se ka taa sport wala jamana bɔrɔ la, a bɛɛ tɛ social media la.
A fɔlɔw sport tɛmɛ jògɔ la.
Kɔfɛ: dɔn.
Kɔfɛ: bɔrɔ.
A ban bɛɛ se ka taa sariya bɛɛ: kɛmɛw.
A fɔlɔw tɛmɛnw ka taa fɔlɔw tɛmɛnw kelenya.
A fɔlɔw sport tɛmɛ jògɔ la: jògɔ kɔfɛ jamana la.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow any sport? I'm really into football.
dialogue.translation: A bɛɛ se ka taa sport wayi? Ayi sɔrɔ football tɛmɛ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I watch basketball. My favorite team is the Lakers, although they don't win every match.
dialogue.translation: Ee, ayi bɛ basketball. Jamana ayi sɔrɔ sanin bɛ Lakers, nka o bɛɛ tɛ dɔɲɛ jògɔ fɛ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: They played against the Celtics last night, right? Who scored the most points?
dialogue.translation: O jògɔ kɔfɛ Celtics jɔ, ee? N baara kɛmɛ kelen di?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yeah, but we lost. Their best player had an amazing game.
dialogue.translation: Ee, nka ayi bɔra. Jògòjà o ye sanin bɛɛ se ka taa jògɔ ka taa fɔlɔw tɛmɛn.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a shame. Do you think they have a chance in the playoffs this season?
dialogue.translation: A tɛ ka sɔrɔ. A bɛɛ se ka taa o saba bɛ playoffs sɛbɛn din ye?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe, but it's hard. Although they have good players, they need to improve their defense.
dialogue.translation: Saba, nka a tɛ ka taama. Nka o bɛ jògòjà ka taa fɔlɔw tɛmɛn, o bɛɛ se ka taa o kɔfɛw kɛmɛ.
